status.description: Result status consumed by kaizen-loop. Use fixed when the scoped implementation is complete, partial when reviewable code was produced but known non-blocking work remains for verifier or human review, and blocked when the builder cannot produce PR-worthy changes without more information, credentials, approval, or an upstream fix.

summary.description: Short implementation summary for the source issue or task.

notes.description: Verification run or skipped, residual risk, reviewer notes, and fallback evidence when relevant. Partial results must provide non-empty Completed scope:, Incomplete scope:, Verification:, and Residual risk: labeled sections.

blockedReason.description: Reason the builder could not complete the task when status is blocked.

humanRequest.description: A concrete unanswered human question. Include only when status is blocked and work cannot continue without the answer or approval.

requestKey.description: Stable semantic identity for the requested decision. Keep it unchanged when only question wording changes.

discoveredIssues.description: Bugs or follow-up issues found while implementing this task. The orchestrator, not Builder Agent, may file these as GitHub issues.

repo.description: Optional target repository or Kaizen component alias such as kaizen-loop, builder-agent, verifier, or .github.
